summary: Moab, Utah couple David Bodner, 69, and Meeche Bodner, 67, became lost while mushroom hunting in the Lizard Head Wilderness on Tuesday afternoon and spent the night out; a family 911 call at 0635 Wednesday reported them lost and cold, with concern Meeche was hypothermic; roughly a dozen SMSO SAR personnel responded with an Olathe Spray Services helicopter plus six Rico Fire members; air contact at 0941 and a quick extrication.
location: Lizard Head Wilderness, Cross Mountain trailhead
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR; Olathe Spray Services helicopter; Rico Fire
notes: DATE CAVEAT: county release is datelined August 26, 2014 but describes the rescue as happening 'Wednesday morning'; 2014-08-27 was the Wednesday (weekday-verified) — occurrence date filed as the rescue day; news-flash item posted 2015-02-11.
